293.text:
BOARD OF ZONING APPEALS
Mission Statement:
To timely and responsibly address commercial and residential land use legislation in the
form of area and use variance proposals, requests for special permits and/or appeals
from special permit criteria, appeals from administrative determinations of Town
officials/Town agencies, requests for interpretation of Town Code, and appeals as the
designated Coastal Erosion Hazard Board of Review and Historic District Advisory Council
Board of Review.
Department Description
The Board of Zoning Appeals is an independent board consisting of seven members
appointed by the Town Board. Its function is to review applications at public hearings
(held an average of twice monthly) for the following: commercial/residential area
variance and use Vanance requests, land divisions, requests for special permits, appeals
from special permit criteria, appeals from administrative determinations of Town
officials/Town agencies, interpretation of Town Code and appeals as the designated
Coastal Erosion Hazard Board of Review and Historic District Advisory Council Board of
Review.
The Board of Zoning Appeals is comprised of two divisions:
The Office of the Board of Zoning Appeals {hereinafter Office) is responsible for the
administration and management of all matters filed with the Board of Zoning Appeals.
This includes processing of applications and submissions, legal notifications
requirements, and interdepartmental and resident communications. In addition, the
Office actively manages the public hearing calendars.
The Boord of Zoning Appeals (hereinafter Board) considers these applications through a
public hearing process and issues its decisions and/or interpretations in a timely manner
in accordance with Town Code requirements. In addition, the members of the Board
are required to attend a minimum of four certified continuing educational training
courses, in both planning and ethics, on a yearly basis in accordance with §85-31(Ajof
the Code.
263

294.text:
Department Accomplishments for 2026

® The Board and the Office have continued to use revised scheduling procedures

to accommodate the continuing high volume of commercial cases. In addition,
the staff has worked diligently to accommodate the new code changes that
affected the commercial and residential calendars.
Without diminishing the significance of previous accomplishments of the past,
the foregoing changes have allowed for a fresh “look” at the existing practices
and procedures. Of particular importance is the timing of the monthly work
sessions and the publication of notice of all scheduled work sessions. These
changes facilitate greater Member participation and increase of public awareness
of the work of the Board. Additionally, on a situation-by- situation basis, there
is a continuing review of scheduling procedures to try, where possible, to
eliminate unnecessary delays.

# Through August of 7026, the complexity and volume of the matters considered
by the Board remained steady. Our staff works diligently to schedule applications
as promptly as reasonably possible in conformity with statutory and code
requirements.

« The Board continues to utilize Civic Clerk in conjunction with its operation and
its communication with the public, Protocols have been established to regulate
office procedure and constituent access to information regarding applications
and Board proceedings.

® The Board has and will continue to comply with the requirements of Sections
267, 267-a and 267-b of the Town Law and the related sections of the Town Code
as the Board reviews applications and appeals.

« The staff of the Office has been cooperating with the Town’s Information
Technology Department in an effort to make the implementation of the online
digital Land Management System seamless with little inconvenience to the
public. The Board of Zoning Appeals’ participation in this new system, (known as
INFOR) is scheduled to be active in September 2026.

« The Board has implemented a new policy regarding Requests for Clarifications of
previous Board decisions. This new policy will make it possible for applicants to
obtain minimal and insignificant modifications of area variances without having
to file a full application to the Board.

284

295.text:
Board of Zoning Appeals Goals for 2027

« The Office will continue to work with the Information Technology Department to
complete a smooth transition to the new online digital Land Management System,
INFOR.

» The Board of Zoning Appeals will continue to work in partnership with the
Building Department, the Law Department and Code Enforcement in support of
the Town Board's effort to confront quality of life issues.

« The Board of Zoning Appeals will continue to work to find ways to expedite the
hearing process without diminishing the rights of the applicants or of the public.

« The Office will assist all applicants with respect to the implementation of
INFOR, the new online digital management system.
